editorial.blurb: A tiny, authentic Nigerian gem where the owner makes everything fresh and the jollof rice is legendary.
editorial.insiderTip: Call ahead before visiting—they sometimes keep the door locked, but you'll be warmly greeted. Go for takeout if you want massive portions (one order easily makes two meals).
